searchText: It looks like the new hotness, 4337, depends on gas observability for proper functioning. I know we discussed some gas changes but a full NOGAS looks to be off the table. https://github.com/eth-infinitism/account-abstraction/blob/develop/contracts/core/EntryPoint.sol#L78 It also has a hard coded gas value (line 231) and passes in a gas limit in it’s call (line 228 & 241). So we need to adjust our gas changes to accommodate this somehow, or count on 4337 receiving market rejection (unlikely based on EthDenver vibe), so we will need to account for it in whatever gas changes are implemented for EOF v1.1 I think the option of ignoring the GAS field in CALL operations and sending all gas is still viable, along with eliminating the 63/64ths rule and removing all stipends. removing the GAS opcode won't work, however, as it is essential to the fee mechanism of the 4337 contract.
